sentences.en: The locals are in the habit of wearing very appealing clothing.
sentences.zh: 当地人习惯穿着非常引人注目的服装。

sentences.en: Algiers has an appealing botanical garden named "Jardin d'essais."
sentences.zh: 阿尔及尔有一个动人的植物园名叫'Jardin d'essais'

sentences.en: Nothing is so appealing as the innocent face of a sleeping baby.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比熟睡的婴儿那张无辜的脸庞更令人着迷了。

senses.zh: 吸引人的；动人的；引起兴趣的；恳求似的
